title: LLM Use for Mental Health: Crowdsourcing Users’ Sentiment-based Perspectives and Values from Social Discussions
reasoning: The study's core methodology is built upon Value-Sensitive Design (VSD), which evaluates interactions through the lens of moral and ethical values such as accountability, informed consent, fairness, and human welfare. These values are systematically extracted and analyzed as primary research variables rather than being confined to a brief ethical considerations section.
